name: assistant
title: Assistant
description: Talk to your brain: ask questions, find capabilities and open what you need.

operations.name: open
operations.description: Compose the assistant surface; input "docked" answers it for the side panel without opening a window.

operations.description: Send a message in the current conversation and answer the run id.

operations.name: transcript
operations.description: Answer the current conversation as JSON.

operations.name: new
operations.description: Start a new conversation and answer its id.

settings.name: Model
settings.description: Model catalog id; empty uses the deployment default.
